papers.summary_zh: LLM 推論服務的快速成長推動了高效多租戶 GPU 排程的需求，但現有系統如 vLLM 在準確估計異質請求的運行成本上面臨挑戰。實際中輸出長度常偏離 admission 時的估計，造成執行時期 token 偏移，導致工作負載不平衡與服務品質下降。本文提出 DriftSched，一個自適應 QoS 感知排程器，能動態監測 token 偏移並調整資源分配與批次策略。實驗證明該方法能有效減少尾延遲並維持較高的整體吞吐量。

primary_link.title: Gate AI: LLM Security Benchmark Evaluation Methodology and Results

papers.summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising partially masked sequences under bidirectional context, exposing a safety surface distinct from autoregressive LLMs. Because mask tokens are native inputs and tokens are committed by confidence rather than position, harmful content can be induced through infilling and outside the monitored prefix. papers.title_zh: SafeSteer：局部化在策略蒸餾實現高效安全對齊

primary_link.title: Overlaying Governance: A Compositional Authorization Framework for Delegation and Scope in Agentic AI

papers.summary_zh: LLM 整合至各領域使知識編輯技術變得關鍵卻具潛在危險。現有編輯方法主要針對原子事實，忽略了操縱事實觀點（如公眾人物對社會議題的立場）的重大風險。此類操縱可能重塑公眾形象、影響選舉、改變社會觀點。本文引入 Factual Opinion Editing 任務與基準，系統性評估知識編輯方法在修改觀點上的能力與風險。結果顯示部分編輯技術可有效改變觀點輸出，引發安全關切，並建議在部署前進行觀點層面的審查。

papers.summary_zh: 傳統查詢優化在代數等價計劃中僅考慮成本差異，但當 LLM 支援的運算子加入後，其放置、順序與粒度共同決定美元成本與答案品質，且最佳選擇常在執行時才浮現。本文將此情境形式化為 agentic query execution，其中基於 agent 的規劃與執行交錯進行，agent 工作單元影響成本與品質。作者提出成本感知優化框架，在規劃階段動態評估不同 agent 配置的成本效益，從而在不犧牲品質的情況下降低執行成本。

papers.title_zh: LLM 微調的安全性測量應基於能力評估

links.title: ARBOR: Online Process Rewards via a Reusable Rubric Buffer for Search Agents

primary_link.title: ARBOR: Online Process Rewards via a Reusable Rubric Buffer for Search Agents

papers.summary: LLM-based search agents are trained predominantly with outcome-only reward, leaving the search process itself unsupervised. This signal degenerates on outcome-homogeneous groups where all sampled trajectories share the same correctness, yielding zero within-group advantage and no gradient. primary_link.title: Right Makes Might: Aligning Verified Hidden States Empowers RL Reasoning

links.title: FederatedSkill: Federated Learning for Agentic Skill Evolution

primary_link.title: FederatedSkill: Federated Learning for Agentic Skill Evolution

papers.summary: Modern LLM agents increasingly rely on skill libraries to handle complex tasks, making skill evolution a primary driver of self-improvement. links.title: Uncertainty-Aware Clarification in LLM Agents with Information Gain

primary_link.title: Uncertainty-Aware Clarification in LLM Agents with Information Gain

papers.summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents often operate under underspecified user instructions, where latent uncertainty over user intent leads to erroneous tool actions. primary_link.title: Capability Advertisement as a Market for Lemons: A Trust Layer for Heterogeneous Agent Networks

primary_link.title: SEA-Embedding: Open and Reproducible Text Embeddings for Southeast Asia

radar.summary_zh: 模型上下文協定已成為連結 LLM 與外部資料及工具的變革性標準，並在個人應用與開發平台上迅速普及。然而，現有基準主要聚焦於通用資訊搜尋工具，未能捕捉個人社交應用中工具與個人帳號或本地資料庫互動所帶來的實際挑戰。為填補此關鍵差距，本文引入 MCP-Persona 基準，透過模擬真實個人應用環境來評估 LLM 代理。該基準包含多樣化個人場景，能更全面反映代理在個人化任務上的能力。
radar.title: MCP-Persona: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Real-World Personal Applications via Environment Simulation
radar.title_zh: MCP-Persona：透過環境模擬基準測試 LLM 代理在真實個人應用中的表現

links.title: On the Scaling of PEFT: Towards Million Personal Models of Trillion Parameters

primary_link.title: On the Scaling of PEFT: Towards Million Personal Models of Trillion Parameters

radar.summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) is usually treated as a cheaper alternative to full fine-tuning. links.title: The Security Budget of Code-LLM Prompt Hardening: Provable Limits Under Pass-Only Acceptance

radar.title_zh: 程式碼 LLM 提示加固的安全預算：僅通過接受下的可證明極限

links.title: MemTrain: Self-Supervised Context Memory Training

primary_link.title: MemTrain: Self-Supervised Context Memory Training

radar.title: MemTrain: Self-Supervised Context Memory Training
radar.title_zh: MemTrain：自監督上下文記憶訓練

links.title: TTT-VLA: Test-Time Latent Prompt Optimization for Vision-Language-Action Models

radar.title: TTT-VLA: Test-Time Latent Prompt Optimization for Vision-Language-Action Models
radar.title_zh: TTT-VLA：視覺-語言-行動模型的測試時潛在提示最佳化

links.title: PhotoCraft: Agentic Reasoning with Hierarchical Self-Evolving Memory for Deep Image Search

radar.summary_zh: 深度影像搜尋需要對豐富上下文線索（如時間、地點和事件關係）進行多步推理。然而，現有基於 LLM 的代理大多是無狀態且反應式的，缺乏持久記憶來維持長程上下文或跨任務傳遞經驗，常導致執行漂移與經驗隔離。為解決這些限制，本文提出 PhotoCraft，一個無需訓練的分層記憶系統，專為照片搜尋代理設計。借鑒人類認知，PhotoCraft 透過短期工作記憶與長期情境記憶協作，實現更準確、連貫的多步影像檢索。實驗顯示其在複雜照片搜尋任務上大幅超越既有方法。
radar.title: PhotoCraft: Agentic Reasoning with Hierarchical Self-Evolving Memory for Deep Image Search
radar.title_zh: PhotoCraft：具有分層自演化記憶的深度影像搜尋代理推理

links.title: Synthetic Hallucinations, Real Gains: Hard Negatives from Frontier Models for FIM Hallucination Mitigation

radar.summary_zh: 驅動 IDE 自動補齊的小型開源程式碼模型仍然會產生幻覺的 Fill-in-the-Middle 補全：語法上看似自然但實際不存在的對方法、參數、變數與匯入的呼叫。現有的緩解方法要麼需要每語言的執行沙箱（不適用於按鍵中途），要麼需要偏好最佳化 pipeline（需要大量人工標註語料）。本文提出一種無需執行的替代方案：使用前沿程式碼模型合成困難負樣本，並利用它們來改善小型模型。這種方法顯著降低了幻覺率，同時避免了人工標註或沙箱需求。
radar.title: Synthetic Hallucinations, Real Gains: Hard Negatives from Frontier Models for FIM Hallucination Mitigation
radar.title_zh: 合成幻覺，真實收益：來自前沿模型的困難負樣本用於 FIM 幻覺緩解

links.title: AI Agents Enable Adaptive Computer Worms

primary_link.title: AI Agents Enable Adaptive Computer Worms

radar.summary: A computer worm is malware that spreads on a network by replicating itself from one machine to another. radar.summary_zh: 電腦蠕蟲是一種透過在網路上自我複製來傳播的惡意軟體。傳統蠕蟲（如 WannaCry）利用預先確定的漏洞，可透過修補這些漏洞來阻止其傳播。本文展示人工智慧代理催生了一種全新的威脅：一種能針對每個目標生成特製攻擊策略的蠕蟲。該蠕蟲寄生性地利用受感染機器運行開源大型語言模型，以適應環境並規劃傳播路徑。這項發現凸顯了 AI 時代網路安全面臨的根本新挑戰。
radar.title: AI Agents Enable Adaptive Computer Worms
radar.title_zh: AI 代理催生自適應電腦蠕蟲

links.title: Trading Human Curation for Synthetic Augmentation in RLVR

primary_link.title: Trading Human Curation for Synthetic Augmentation in RLVR

radar.title: Trading Human Curation for Synthetic Augmentation in RLVR
radar.title_zh: 以合成擴增取代人工策展進行 RLVR

links.title: E2LLM: Towards Efficient LLM Serving in Heterogeneous Edge/Fog Environments

primary_link.title: E2LLM: Towards Efficient LLM Serving in Heterogeneous Edge/Fog Environments

radar.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have become integral to modern applications, yet their deployment remains challenging. Beyond executing the models themselves, practical deployment must address cost efficiency, low latency, and optimal resource utilization. radar.title: E2LLM: Towards Efficient LLM Serving in Heterogeneous Edge/Fog Environments
radar.title_zh: E2LLM：在異構邊緣/霧環境中實現高效的 LLM 服務

links.title: HybridThinker: Efficient Chain-of-Thought Reasoning via Compressed Memory and Transient Thought Steps

primary_link.title: HybridThinker: Efficient Chain-of-Thought Reasoning via Compressed Memory and Transient Thought Steps

radar.title: HybridThinker: Efficient Chain-of-Thought Reasoning via Compressed Memory and Transient Thought Steps
radar.title_zh: HybridThinker：透過壓縮記憶與瞬時思考步驟實現高效的思維鏈推理

links.title: SafeGene: Reusable Adapters for Transferable Safety Alignment

primary_link.title: SafeGene: Reusable Adapters for Transferable Safety Alignment

radar.title: SafeGene: Reusable Adapters for Transferable Safety Alignment
radar.title_zh: SafeGene：可重複使用的適配器實現可轉移的安全對齊

links.title: Compress then Merge: From Multiple LoRAs into One Low-Rank Adapter

primary_link.title: Compress then Merge: From Multiple LoRAs into One Low-Rank Adapter

links.title: Investigating Adversarial Robustness of Multi-modal Large Language Models

links.title: RogueMerge: Robust and Unified Attacks against LLM Model Merging

top5.summary_zh: LLM 演進為具工具使用能力的智能體，帶來了與真實世界執行相關的新安全挑戰，而非僅是文字生成。傳統的對齊方法往往依賴粗略的拒絕訊號或靜態監督，難以在各種智能體風險之間平衡安全性與實用工具執行。本文提出 RUBAS，一個基於評分標準的強化學習框架，將智能體行為分解為工具使用安全、任務忠誠度、信息保護與行為邊界四個維度。透過評分標準引導的獎勵設計，RUBAS 能在保持工具效用的同時，有效降低有害行為的發生率。
